'''Tak Bazierre''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with the rank of [[First Sergeant/Legends|First Sergeant]]. Like other [[GeNode]] [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of his batch, an early one that was eventually discontinued, he was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] with greasy [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and a face that [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Wayson Dower]] regarded as cruel.<ref name="Pax Empirica" />

During the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Imperial occupation of Kashyyyk]], Bazierre was assigned to [[Janzor]]'s [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]]. While en route to their landing site, Bazierre saw that Dower had his [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] off. He ordered the corporal to put it on and identify the alert status that he had just signaled, using the exact phrasings that Dower had just heard from First Sergeant [[Oswald Strepp]], another clone from his batch. When Bazierre walked away, Dower rhetorically asked his friend [[Milo Strander]] if the sergeants were half [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="Pax Empirica" />

As the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] approached its landing on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], it struck a thick [[Tree/Legends|tree]] branch that tipped the ship on its side. Bazierre was standing too close to the open door and his [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], designed for protection rather than grip, interfered with securing a handhold. When he fell from the transport, he landed on a branch that broke his [[Bone/Legends|spine]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him. Bazierre thus became the first Imperial casualty of the battle with the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].<ref name="Pax Empirica" />
